parsed.post: Increased DEPTH from 4 to 6, resulting in a significant improvement (1.044 -> 1.014). Capacity increase seems highly effective despite the fixed time budget. Next, I will test if increasing ASPECT_RATIO further improves performance or if it hits diminishing returns.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO from 48 to 64 to further increase model capacity/context window, building on the successful DEPTH increase.
